veranderings.voor: vir almal oopgemaak en het dit baie makliker geword
veranderings.na: vir almal oopgemaak, en het dit baie makliker geword
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two clauses with their own subject and verb ('die internet is oopgemaak' and 'dit het geword'), so a comma goes before it.

veranderings.voor: van waar jy ook al is
veranderings.rede: 'van waar jy ook al is' copies English 'from wherever you are'; idiomatic Afrikaans is 'waar jy ook al is', and it saves a word.

vlae.teks: Hospitale, banke en winkels werk elke dag hiermee. / Skole en laboratoriums bewaar hulle inligting op rekenaars.
vlae.rede: The heading asks 'what for' and the first five items answer with 'Om ...', but the last two are full sentences about who uses computers, so the list breaks its pattern; 'hiermee' also has nothing in its own item to refer back to. Making them match would mean rewording content, so this is for the writer to decide, not a language change.
